title: Use GPT 5.6 Inside Claude Code
description:
You don't need to pick one model.

You need to split the job.

Frontier pricing exists for a reason.

That reason is judgment, not typing.

Most tokens go to execution.

Execution doesn't need a genius.

It needs someone who follows instructions.

So let the expensive model think.

Fable 5 does the thinking.

GPT 5.6 does the typing.

Work passes back and forth.

Until the whole project's done.

Same output. Half the tokens.

Like an architect who draws the blueprint.

The crew still swings the hammer.

You weren't choosing the wrong model.

You were paying one model to do two jobs.

Split the job. Keep the results.

#fable5 #gpt56 #tokens #aimodels #airesearch
